title: Cloudflare 推出 tsrs：由 Claude Opus 5.5 Agent 主导移植的 TypeScript 编译器 Rust 版，类型检查提速最高 8 倍
summary: 今天最热的一条：Cloudflare 联合 VoidZero、Owner.com 推出 tsrs——TypeScript 编译器的 Rust 移植版，移植过程几乎全由 Claude Opus 5.5 Agent 驱动，实测类型检查提速 5.3 倍、内存少 72%，而微软用两年和整个团队写的 Go 版本 tsgo 被「几周做完」抢了风头。
summary_en: Cloudflare, VoidZero, and Owner.com reportedly introduced tsrs, a Rust port of TypeScript’s compiler. The migration was said to have been driven almost entirely by a Claude Opus 5.5 Agent and completed in weeks. Early tests claim type checking is 5.3 times faster and uses 72% less memory, with speedups of up to eight times, while contrasting the effort with Microsoft’s two-year, team-developed Go version, tsgo.
